mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with telmisartan (ARB) increases risk of severe hypotension and hypertensive crisis due to sympathomimetic potentiation and additive vasodilatory effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor blood pressure very closely; consider alternative antidepressant if telmisartan is essential, or switch to non-MAOI antidepressant.
